chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Charlie Shavers's writing and style with Kirby
summary: They credit Charlie Shavers and pianist Billy Kyle with writing for the Kirby band; Dickenson calls his style the greatest.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I guess Charlie Shavers really did a lot of the writing.
I think so. Yes, I'm sure he did. He and the pianist...
Billy Kyle, yes. And Charlie Shavers was just, you know... I don't know. He had nobody to be a peer,
to have a peer, really. He was just great. He was just great. Everybody has their own style, and his style was just the greatest. Just the greatest.
Yeah, he was a marvelous musician. And he played lead and wrote...
